summary: Enhance your skills with our Integrated IT and Enterprise Architecture Training Course. Gain practical knowledge to excel in today's tech-driven landscape.
lede: IT architecture training helps architects and IT planners connect business capabilities with applications, data flows and technology decisions. Participants learn to map capabilities, assess application portfolios and dependencies, and model target architectures. They also practice evaluating solution options and prioritizing a transition roadmap for governance and executive review.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who contribute to enterprise architecture, IT planning, solution design, technology governance, or digital transformation. It is designed for roles that need to connect business direction with practical architecture decisions.
modules: Architecture Governance with COBIT and ITIL
prerequisites: No programming background is required. You should have access to a laptop and basic experience working with IT documentation, process maps, application information, or technology investment proposals. Advanced concepts such as AI-assisted portfolio analysis and repository governance receive operational application or conceptual coverage rather than production engineering depth.
